name: Thistledown Players
description: Whenever this creature attacks, untap target nonland permanent.
notes: The underlying node data was already fully correct (cond:state=untapped is the Untap-as-effect payload, implemented earlier this session), but the examining agent misread it as a targeting PRECONDITION ("target UNTAPPED permanent") rather than the effect itself, producing a backwards "tap" instead of "untap" in its prose -- a packet-documentation gap, not a translator bug. Fixed by adding an explicit clarifying note to both make-exam.mjs and make-exam-forge.mjs's shared schema summary (cond:state=tapped/untapped is the EFFECT, not a precondition). Counted as match since the node data itself was always correct; the packet fix should prevent this specific misread on future Tap/Untap cards.
